headline: A 2017 executive order calls for a federal plan to make sure the U.S. has steady, secure supplies of critical minerals.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs the federal government to create a strategy for securing reliable supplies of critical minerals. These are minerals the country depends on and could have trouble getting. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, agencies, and deadlines in the order are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They would be involved in developing and carrying out a national strategy on critical mineral supplies.
A federal strategy on mineral supplies could affect the policies that apply to their industry.
Businesses that depend on these minerals could be affected by federal efforts to change how supplies are secured.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 20, 2017; executive orders generally take effect when signed.
